QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Will of the World
QuestInfo.0: The Executor that manifested from Tana's will guide you and Ollie. Follow them.
QuestInfo.1: You discovered deformed Erda where the Executor guided you to. Seeing how the Erda was becoming real, you are getting closer to Tana. Look at the Erda and follow the traces of Tana.
QuestInfo.2: Judging from Tana's memories, and her use of the #bpower of light#k, she must also be known as Aeona. But why did she call herself Tana?
